AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-54
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
i.
Introduction & Presentation of PVEPD’s Volunteers in Police Service (VIPS)
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 9a-b)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #9a-b) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Draft City Council Action Minutes
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
November 13, 2018; Special Meeting
b.
November 27, 2018; Regular Meeting
Minutes
3.
Demands of December 11, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of November 30, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of December 11, 2018
Demands
4.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
5.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - November 30, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
6.
Consideration of Second Amendment to the Concession Agreement Between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation and the Proposed 2019 Budget with an Adjustment of Monthly Member Dues
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider Amendment No. 2 to the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation concession agreement and the proposed 2019 Budget with the monthly dues increase.
Staff Report
7.
Adoption on Second Reading of Ordinance No. O18-734; An Ordinance of the City Council Amending Sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to Define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to Establish Procedures and Standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family Residential Zones
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. O18-734 amending sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to establish procedures and standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family residential zones.
Staff Report
8.
Corrective Resolution for R18-51 Updating Sworn Police Management
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution R18-51C for the Sworn Police Management group.
Staff Report
9.
Planning Commission Actions of November 20, 2018
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
a.
M-1287-18; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for fencing exceeding the allowable height within the setback adjacent to the street at the single family residence located at 801 Via Conejo. Lot 1, Block 1536, Tract 6884. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Sarah & Robert Akin
Actions: Approved the application on consent (3-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) The existing hedge within the public right-of-way is a non-standard encroachment and shall be removed. Plant height on right-of-way shall be less than 30 inches, with no hedges.
b.
NC-1632/G-1620-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility & Grading Applications for a new single family residence located at 1620 Espinosa Circle. Lot 1, Block 1374, Tract 6889. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Brett Buchmann
746 4th St.
Hermosa Beach, CA 90254
Owner: Milton Street Residential
124 S. Guadalupe
Redondo Beach, CA 90278
Actions: Approved the application (3-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional condition: 1) Any existing nonstandard encroachments within the right-of-way, including, but not limited to the existing rock wall, shall be removed. 2) Runoff from watershed tributary to the boundaries of the proposed project shall be intercepted and conveyed through the site to the street. 3) A Hollywood Berm shall be constructed, per City standards, along the frontage of the property.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
NEW BUSINESS
13.
Presentation of the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Period Ending June 30, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
14.
Consideration of Concession Agreement between the City of Palos Verdes Estates and the Palos Verdes Golf Club
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider approving a 20-year concession agreement, with options for two 10-year extensions, with the Palos Verdes Golf Club (PVGC).
Staff Report
15.
Consideration of Implementing an Integrated Pest Management Policy
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for implementing an integrated pest management policy and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING
10.
Request to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of NC-1626-18; Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a Remodel and Addition to an Existing Single-Family Residence Located at 1509 Espinosa Circle. Lot 20, Block 1376, Tract 6889 (This Project is Exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearing, receive public input, close the public hearing, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
11.
Consideration of a Concession Agreement for the Palos Verdes Stable Operations, Maintenance, and Facility Improvements Effective March 1, 2019 for 10-Years
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the proposed 10-year Concession Agreement with Megan and Greg Padilla effective March 1, 2019 for Palos Verdes Stable operations, maintenance and capital improvements.
Staff Report
12.
Consideration of the Finance Advisory Committee Meeting at the Palos Verdes Golf Club on January 15, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council determine whether or not the Finance Advisory Committee should meet on January 15, 2019 at the Palos Verdes Golf Club and audio record the meeting without video recording and live-streaming.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
16.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
17.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 9, 2018, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door and inside adjacent to Council Chambers located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, Palos Verdes Golf Club, and Malaga Cove Library not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54954.2. Dated this 7th day of December, 2018.
